name: Talhindir's Grief
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
description: Gentle crying rises to become overwhelming wails. The fungal carvings begin to weep blood that pools around the pillars
disable: DC 17 Performance (trained) to overpower the frightening cries with a greater sound or DC 15 Occultism or DC 15 Religion (trained) to ritually disrupt the haunting.
reset: If the haunt is not dispersed, it resets after 1 day.

defensiveAbilities.name: The Falling Tears
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the carving of Viore Ciobanu

Effect The fungus statues weep blood, and their cries deal (2d6+5) Mental Damage damage to living creatures within the room (Basic DC 17 Will Saving Throw save). On a failed save, creatures are also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure)
